answer: No. Since February 1, 2026, the power of attorney is form NW-POA-2, which your dad can sign electronically with no notary; only Georgia still requires notarization. The older notarized form NW-POA-1 is no longer accepted, because the grace period for it ended June 30, 2026. Bring the signed NW-POA-2, your own photo ID (in Virginia, a state mobile ID on your phone is accepted), and the car's documents.
